official: 官方在线 2026-09-09 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: This paper refers to interview data collected in six municipalities in the Lecce province of southern Italy, across three waves: 2020, 2021, and 2022. The principal aim of the research was to determine whether compliance with four government-recommended non-pharmaceutical measures to prevent the spread of COVID-19 — indoor and outdoor mask use, and indoor and outdoor physical distancing — differed over the years and, if so, whether these differences were influenced by personal characteristics. Specifically, we focused on the psychological features of self-control, risk aversion, and fear of contracting COVID-19 and their relationships with these four measures. The results suggest that virus mortality, the regulations in force, and experience of the pandemic affected compliance with certain preventive measures across all waves. With regard to psychological features, the three factors of interest were found to predict preferences for, and substitutions across, the measures, with effects that varied across the waves.

official: 官方在线 2026-09-03 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: We study age discrimination in a labor market with a job ladder, where worker productivity is revealed over time. Using data from a large Chinese recruitment platform that links job postings, applications, and employer responses, we document sharp declines in applications and callbacks at posted age cutoffs. Discrimination operates in both directions: older applicants are disadvantaged in entry-level jobs, while younger applicants are less likely to be hired into managerial roles. A model of statistical discrimination with imperfect signal screening explains these patterns. Consistent with the model, older applicants to entry-level jobs are negatively selected relative to their peers.

title: Please Take a Minute: How Prosocial Choices Change with Deliberation
title_zh: 请花一分钟：深思熟虑如何改变亲社会选择
title_primary: 请花一分钟：深思熟虑如何改变亲社会选择
title_secondary: Please Take a Minute: How Prosocial Choices Change with Deliberation
authors: Kessler, Judd B., Kivimaki, Hannu, Litwin, Ashley, Niederle, Muriel
official: 来源期次 American Economic Journal: Microeconomics · 来源：期刊官网
abstract: People often make decisions quickly when presented with a choice. Are their initial answers a good approximation of what they would choose if they took more time to decide? We explore how individuals’ choices change with deliberation and find that later choices systematically differ from early ones. We focus on prosocial decisions and find that individuals’ choices respond more to social efficiency as they deliberate over the course of a minute. Our results call into question the use of revealed preference for welfare when prosocial choices are made quickly and provide guidance to policy makers and charities.
abstract_zh: 人们在面临选择时往往迅速做出决定。他们最初的回答是否很好地近似于若花更多时间思考后可能做出的选择？我们探讨了个体选择如何随深思熟虑而变化，并发现后来的选择与早期选择存在系统性差异。我们聚焦于亲社会决策，发现随着个体在一分钟内进行思考，其选择对社会效率的响应程度增强。我们的结果对在快速做出亲社会选择时使用显示性偏好进行福利评估提出了质疑，并为政策制定者和慈善机构提供了指导。

title: Financing Property Rights: Fee-Financed Registration and Unequal Formalisation in Spain, 1845–1935
title_zh: 融资产权：西班牙收费登记与不平等正规化，1845-1935
title_primary: 融资产权：西班牙收费登记与不平等正规化，1845-1935
title_secondary: Financing Property Rights: Fee-Financed Registration and Unequal Formalisation in Spain, 1845–1935
authors: Joan R. Rosés, Juan Carmona
official: 官方在线 2026-09-02 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: This paper argues that the financing model of property-rights institutions is a central determinant of their distributional consequences. Following the Napoleonic reforms, Spain’s Liberal governments created a modern, nationally integrated land registry, but financed access through user fees and tied registration to the collection of transfer taxes. This arrangement reduced the administrative cost of reform and gave the Treasury transaction revenue at a time when the cadastral basis of direct land taxation was increasingly obsolete. Yet it also created a regressive access regime: because notarial fees, registry charges, and taxes were largely fixed, the proportional cost of formalisation was highest for low-value and fragmented properties. Drawing on fee schedules, fiscal series, and provincial evidence, the paper reconstructs this cost structure, documents the growing fiscal weight of transaction taxation, and shows that the incidence of formalisation costs was greatest where registry participation was weakest. Because pricing produced the exclusion rather than incomplete coverage, extending such a registry need not narrow inequality and may reproduce it. Spain’s experience shows that a legally universal property-rights institution could remain economically unequal in practice, and that the funding model should be treated as a first-order variable in explaining its historical performance.
abstract_zh: 本文认为，产权制度的融资模式是其分配后果的核心决定因素。继拿破仑改革之后，西班牙自由派政府创建了一个现代、全国一体化的土地登记体系，但通过用户费用为其提供资金，并将登记与转让税的征收挂钩。这一安排在直接土地税的测地基础日益过时之际，降低了改革的行政成本，并为国库带来了交易收入。然而，这也造成了一种累退性的准入制度：由于公证费、登记费及税费大体固定，正式化的比例成本对低价值及碎片化财产最高。借助费用表、财政序列及省级证据，本文重构了这一成本结构，记录了交易税财政权重的增长，并表明正式化成本的负担在登记参与最薄弱的地区最为沉重。由于定价导致了排斥而非覆盖不全，扩展此类登记体系未必能缩小不平等，反而可能使其再生产。西班牙的经验表明，一个法律上普遍适用的产权制度在实践中可能仍保持经济上的不平等，且融资模式应被视为解释其历史绩效的一阶变量。

title: Educating like China
title_zh: 像中国一样教育
title_primary: 像中国一样教育

authors: Federica Coelli, Yuan Zi, Difei Ouyang, Weidi Yuan
official: 官方在线 2026-09-01 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: This paper shows that human capital accumulation can accelerate structural transformation without accelerating growth. We study China’s 1999 higher education expansion, a large, rapid, and largely unanticipated increase in college graduates. We find that more exposed prefectures experienced larger increases in the skilled-labor share and shifted employment and value added from agriculture toward services. The reallocation extended to low-skilled workers. Consumer services absorbed most of the increase in employment, while producer services accounted for a disproportionate share of high-skilled employment growth. Yet more-exposed prefectures did not grow faster. A four-sector model rationalizes these patterns, showing how greater skill supply can generate broad-based servitization, but also a Baumol-type growth penalty when labor reallocates toward slower-growing sectors. Our findings highlight that the payoff to higher education depends not only on how much skill it creates, but also on whether the resulting structural transformation directs resources toward the economy’s engines of productivity growth.
abstract_zh: 本文表明，人力资本积累能够加速结构转型，却未必加速经济增长。我们研究了中国1999年的高等教育扩张，这是一次大规模、迅速且在很大程度上未预料到的大学生数量激增。我们发现，受影响较大的地级市经历了技能劳动力份额的更大增长，并将就业和增加值从农业转向服务业。这种重新配置也延伸至低技能劳动者。消费服务业吸收了就业增长的大部分，而生产性服务业则在高端技能就业增长中占据了不成比例的份额。然而，受影响较大的地级市并未实现更快的经济增长。一个四部门模型合理化了这些现象，展示了技能供给增加如何引发广泛的“服务化”，但当劳动力重新配置向增长较慢的部门时，也可能带来鲍莫尔式的增长惩罚。我们的发现强调，高等教育的回报不仅取决于其创造的技能数量，还取决于由此产生的结构转型是否将资源导向经济中生产率增长的引擎。

title: Comparative advantage and the quality choice of heterogeneous firms
title_zh: 比较优势与异质性企业的质量选择
title_primary: 比较优势与异质性企业的质量选择
title_secondary: Comparative advantage and the quality choice of heterogeneous firms
authors: Antonio Navas, Dongzhe Zhang, Ian Gregory-Smith
official: 官方在线 2026-08-28 · 来源：RSS
abstract: This paper explores the role played by comparative advantage in shaping the impact that trade has on a firm’s product quality across industries. We develop a Heckscher-Ohlin model with firm heterogeneity and endogenous quality upgrading. Trade openness increases an exporter’s product quality differently across industries, with a larger effect in a country’s comparative advantage industry. Differences in factor endowments across countries translate into differences in factor prices which affect the firm’s marginal costs of production. The cost-advantage that firms enjoy in a country’s comparative advantage industry increases firm’s prospective market size abroad, increasing the incentives to invest in product quality. Introducing endogenous firm-level comparative advantage based on differences in factor intensity within an industry, reveals that the firm’s response to trade openness in terms of quality choice is shaped by the firm and industry determinants of comparative advantage: Firms that use more intensively the factor in which the country is more abundant will increase quality to a larger extent. Using transaction-level data from Chinese firms, we find empirical support for the model predictions; Chinese exporters produce higher-quality products in those industries in which China reveals a comparative advantage.
abstract_zh: 本文探讨了比较优势在塑造贸易对企业跨行业产品质量影响中所扮演的角色。我们构建了一个包含企业异质性与内生质量升级的赫克歇尔-俄林模型。贸易开放对不同行业出口商产品质量的提升作用存在差异，且在一国具有比较优势的行业中效应更为显著。各国要素禀赋的差异转化为要素价格的差异，进而影响企业的边际生产成本。企业在国家比较优势行业中所享有的成本优势扩大了其海外潜在市场规模，从而增强了投资于产品质量的激励。通过引入基于行业内要素密集度差异的企业层面内生比较优势，我们发现企业对贸易开放的质量选择反应受企业及行业比较优势决定因素的共同影响：更密集使用该国相对充裕要素的企业，其质量提升幅度更大。利用中国企业交易层面的数据，我们为模型预测提供了实证支持；中国出口商在其显示比较优势的行业中生产更高质量的产品。

title: Critical Minerals, Geopolitics, and the Green Transition
title_zh: 关键矿产、地缘政治与绿色转型
title_primary: 关键矿产、地缘政治与绿色转型
title_secondary: Critical Minerals, Geopolitics, and the Green Transition
authors: Tomás Domínguez-Iino, Jonathan T. Elliott, Allan Hsiao
official: 官方在线 2026-08-24 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: The green energy transition will be powered by the mining and processing of lithium, nickel, and cobalt, which are critical for the production of advanced batteries. These minerals are concentrated geographically but traded globally, allowing key mining countries to exercise market power through policy intervention. Advanced batteries use multiple minerals in combination, and this joint use creates interdependence across mineral markets. We study the geopolitical implications of these forces and their consequences for green technology adoption worldwide. We quantify supply chain vulnerability, international policy spillovers, and the potential for mineral cartels.
abstract_zh: 绿色能源转型将由锂、镍和钴的开采与加工驱动，这些矿物对先进电池的生产至关重要。这些矿物在地理上集中分布，但全球范围内交易，使得主要采矿国能够通过政策干预行使市场力量。先进电池组合使用多种矿物，这种联合使用在矿物市场间形成了相互依存关系。我们研究这些力量的地缘政治影响及其对全球绿色技术采纳的后果。我们量化供应链脆弱性、国际政策溢出效应以及矿物卡特尔的可能性。

title: Information Technology and Credit: Evidence from Public Guarantees
title_zh: 信息技术与信贷：来自公共担保的证据
title_primary: 信息技术与信贷：来自公共担保的证据
title_secondary: Information Technology and Credit: Evidence from Public Guarantees
authors: Fabrizio Core, Filippo De Marco
official: 官方在线 2021-02-11 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: This paper investigates whether banks' information technology (IT) can substitute for local branch presence in the provision of small business credit. Our identification strategy relies on loan-level data and the unique institutional features of the Italian public guarantee scheme during Covid-19. Despite the availability of online applications and low screening incentives, small business lending remains local, even for first-time borrowers. However, IT partly mitigates the impact of local branch presence: banks with better IT provide more, cheaper and faster guaranteed loans and lend more in areas where they have no bank branches, especially to first-time borrowers.
abstract_zh: 本文探讨了银行的信息技术（IT）是否能在小企业信贷供给中替代当地分支机构的存在。我们的识别策略依赖于贷款层面的数据以及意大利在新冠疫情期间公共担保计划的独特制度特征。尽管在线申请可用且筛选激励较低，小企业贷款仍保持本地化，即便是对首次借款人也是如此。然而，IT在一定程度上缓解了当地分支机构存在的影响：拥有更优IT的银行提供更多、更便宜且更快的担保贷款，并在其无分支机构的地区发放更多贷款，尤其是面向首次借款人。

title: ¿Cómo desarrollar las competencias de los líderes de la escuela? Un estudio del programa Rectores Líderes Transformadores (RLT)
title_zh: 如何培养学校领导者的能力？——基于“变革型校长领导力”项目（RLT）的研究
title_primary: 如何培养学校领导者的能力？——基于“变革型校长领导力”项目（RLT）的研究
title_secondary: ¿Cómo desarrollar las competencias de los líderes de la escuela? Un estudio del programa Rectores Líderes Transformadores (RLT)
authors: Bayona Rodríguez, Hernando, Álvarez Hernández, Jenifer Andrea, Barros Rincón, Adriana
official: 官方在线 2026-08-17 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: Mientras está bien documentada la importancia del liderazgo de los rectores, poco se sabe sobre cómo desarrollar sus competencias, especialmente entre aquellos que están en ejercicio. La presente investigación estudia cómo el programa más importante de desarrollo profesional de rectores en Colombia, Rectores Líderes Transformadores (RLT), promueve las competencias necesarias para el ejercicio del liderazgo. Haciendo seguimiento a dos cohortes del programa durante dos años, se encuentran cinco acciones concretas e intencionadas que RLT implementa para impulsar las competencias de los rectores: (i) hacer énfasis en las competencias personales; ii) crear ambientes adecuados para la relación entre pares; iii) propiciar múltiples espacios de reflexión; iv) realizar acompañamiento directo; v) entregar herramientas prácticas y efectivas. A pesar de que RLT impulsa importantes habilidades, los resultados sugieren que el programa no desarrolla algunas competencias cruciales para el ejercicio del liderazgo educativo tales como gestión del cambio, innovación, negociación, toma de decisiones, manejo de conflictos, pensamiento estratégico, pensamiento sistémico y tolerancia a la presión. Finalmente, se concluye que las metodologías experienciales y el enfoque en el desarrollo del ser, son las que potencian el desarrollo de las demás competencias.
abstract_zh: 尽管校长领导力的重要性已有充分文献记载，但关于如何培养其能力，尤其是在职校长的能力发展方面，相关研究仍较为匮乏。本研究探讨了哥伦比亚最重要的校长专业发展项目——“变革型领导者校长项目”（RLT）如何促进校长行使领导力所需的能力。通过对该项目两届学员为期两年的跟踪调查，研究发现RLT实施了五项具体且有意的行动来推动校长能力提升：（i）强调个人能力；（ii）营造有利于同伴关系的环境；（iii）提供多种反思空间；（iv）开展直接辅导；（v）提供实用有效的工具。尽管RLT推动了重要技能的发展，但研究结果表明，该项目并未培养教育领导力实践中某些关键能力，如变革管理、创新、谈判、决策、冲突处理、战略思维、系统思维以及抗压能力。最后，研究得出结论：体验式方法论和以“人的发展”为核心的取向，是促进其他能力发展的关键因素。

title: Voting green, or not: what drives members of the European Parliament opposition to agri-environmental reform?
title_zh: 投票绿色，还是不投票：什么驱动欧洲议会议员反对农业环境改革？
title_primary: 投票绿色，还是不投票：什么驱动欧洲议会议员反对农业环境改革？
title_secondary: Voting green, or not: what drives members of the European Parliament opposition to agri-environmental reform?
authors: Joaquín Villa-García, Jeroen Candel, Nicolas W. Jager
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-08-13 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Substantive agri-environmental policy change has not materialized within EU agri-food governance despite emerging scientific consensus on the need for food system transformation. Agri-environmental legislative proposals often face strong resistance, resulting in their weakening or reversal. Although the challenges to adopting agri-environmental legislations are clear, existing analytical tools fall short in explaining why legislative rollbacks occur. This study addresses this gap by drawing on Rational Choice Theory to examine how individual-level motivations linked to the agri-food sector influence members of the European Parliament (MEP) voting behaviour on agri-environmental legislation. Roll-call vote data and a binomial generalized linear mixed model are used to test office-seeking, policy-seeking and vote-seeking motivations. Our analysis shows that MEPs with private financial interests in the agri-food sector were more likely to vote against environmental protection across the studied agri-environmental legislations, while MEPs with stronger environmental ideological affinity were more likely to support such measures. Institutional variables, mainly political group affiliation and COMAGRI leadership of legislative files, are also significant determinants of voting behaviour. These findings suggest that individual-level motivations and institutional structures help explain the lack of consistent legislative support for agri-environmental legislations between February 2022 and July 2024. Our findings raise normative questions about the need for stronger transparency and conflict-of-interest measures in EU agricultural governance.
abstract_zh: 尽管科学界对食品体系转型的必要性已形成共识，欧盟农业食品治理中实质性的农业环境政策变革仍未实现。农业环境立法提案常遭遇强烈抵制，导致其被削弱或逆转。尽管采纳农业环境立法的挑战显而易见，现有分析工具却难以解释立法倒退何以发生。本研究通过借鉴理性选择理论，探讨与农业食品部门相关的个体层面动机如何影响欧洲议会（MEP）议员在农业环境立法上的投票行为，以填补这一研究空白。研究采用唱名表决数据及二项广义线性混合模型，检验了追求职位、追求政策及追求选票三类动机。分析结果显示，在农业食品部门拥有私人财务利益的欧洲议会议员更倾向于在研究的各项农业环境立法中投票反对环境保护，而具有更强环境意识形态倾向的议员则更可能支持此类措施。制度变量，主要是政治团体归属及立法档案的COMAGRI主导权，也是投票行为的重要决定因素。这些发现表明，个体层面动机与制度结构共同解释了2022年2月至2024年7月期间农业环境立法缺乏一贯立法支持的现象。我们的研究结果引发了关于欧盟农业治理中加强透明度与利益冲突管理措施必要性的规范性思考。

title: The Race between Population and Technology: Real wages in the First Industrial Revolution
title_zh: 人口与技术的赛跑：第一次工业革命中的实际工资
title_primary: 人口与技术的赛跑：第一次工业革命中的实际工资
title_secondary: The Race between Population and Technology: Real wages in the First Industrial Revolution
authors: Nicholas Crafts, Terence Mills
official: 官方在线 2020-08-17 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: We investigate a structural model of demographic-economic interactions for England during 1570 to 1850. We estimate that the annual rate of population growth consistent with constant real wages was 0.4 per cent before 1760 but 1.5 per cent thereafter. We find that exogenous shocks increased population growth dramatically in the early decades of the Industrial Revolution. Simulations of our model show that if these demographic shocks had occurred before the Industrial revolution the impact on real wages would have been catastrophic and that these shocks were largely responsible for very slow growth of real wages during the Industrial Revolution.
abstract_zh: 我们研究了一个针对1570年至1850年间英格兰人口与经济互动的结构模型。我们估算，在1760年之前，与恒定实际工资相符合的人口年增长率为0.4%，而此后则为1.5%。我们发现，外生冲击在工业革命早期几十年间显著促进了人口增长。模型模拟显示，若这些人口冲击发生在工业革命之前，其对实际工资的影响将是灾难性的，并且这些冲击在很大程度上导致了工业革命期间实际工资增长极为缓慢。

title: From Canvas to Blockchain: Impact of Royalties on Art Market Efficiency

abstract: This paper estimates the average causal effect of access to subsidized before‐ and after‐school care on the labour market outcomes of mothers. Specifically, we analyze a major policy reform implemented in Quebec (Canada) in 1998, which required all public primary schools to provide before‐ and after‐school care at a low fixed fee, thereby reducing costs and expanding availability for families. We identify the intent‐to‐treat effect of the reform on service use and maternal labour market outcomes using administrative tax return data and a triple difference design. We find that, 7 years after implementation, the policy led to a substantial increase in mothers' use of childcare programs and raised their average annual labour income by 7%. These income gains are primarily driven by higher income among working mothers, rather than increased employment rates.

abstract: This paper investigates how telecommunications infrastructure affects economic growth. This issue is important and has received considerable attention in the popular press concerning the creation of the 'information superhighway' and its potential impacts on the economy. We use evidence from 21 OECD countries over a twenty-year period to examine the impacts that telecommunications developments may have had. We estimate a structural model, which endogenizes telecommunication investment by specifying a micro-model of supply and demand for telecommunication investments. The micro-model is then jointly estimated with the macro-growth equation. After controlling for country-specific fixed effects, we find evidence of a significant positive causal link, especially when a critical mass of telecommunications infrastructure is present. Interestingly, the critical mass appears to be at a level of telecommunications infrastructure that is near universal service.

abstract: We present a behavioural heterogeneous agents model of the foreign exchange (FX) market designed from the perspective of a developing economy that cannot trade in its national currency. The model distinguishes between speculative and non-speculative FX sectors. We show that, as long as non-speculative demand responds to domestic economic activity, a market-clearing output growth rate exists that, in the steady state, equals the ratio of FX supply growth to the income elasticity of demand for foreign assets, i.e., a generalised dynamic trade multiplier. The model is compatible with endogenous persistent and bounded fluctuations, and the analysis of the basins of attraction reveals coexistence of fixed points and chaotic attractors. Numerical simulations reproduce key stylised facts of exchange rate dynamics, including non-Gaussian distributions, consistent with evidence from Latin American economies. Time-varying parameter estimation confirms that the dynamic trade multiplier closely tracks observed growth rates in the region.

abstract: Promoting green innovation agglomeration (GIA) is essential for achieving a sustainable industrial transformation, strengthening resource efficiency and advancing the low-carbon progression. However, the role of eco-industrial demonstration parks (EIDPs) in fostering GIA remains insufficiently explored. Using panel data from 297 prefecture-level cities in China for the period 2000–2022, this study systematically examines the impact of EIDPs on GIA. The empirical results show that (1) EIDPs significantly promote GIA, a conclusion that maintains its validity through robustness and endogeneity checks. (2) Heterogeneity checks indicate that the EIDPs’ effect is more evident among cities possessing high government governance capacity, high environmental preference, and high market spillover level. (3) A mechanism analysis reveals that EIDPs enhance GIA by improving green technology diversity, innovation factors’ allocation efficiency and external media coverage. Such outcomes enrich research on EIDPs and GIA and provide policy insights for optimizing EIDPs’ governance, improving green innovation resource allocation, and accelerating the formation of regionally coordinated green innovation systems.

abstract: We model the interaction between shareholder trading and voting on firm policies that create externalities for which investors have heterogenous preferences, and we test the model’s equilibrium predictions in the laboratory. The model suggests, and laboratory results confirm, that low policy costs favor policy adoption while intermediate costs lead to a lower policy adoption rate under dispersed preferences than under polarized preferences. Observed share prices are higher than equilibrium predictions when the policy is adopted and are close to the fundamental value of the firm had the policy not been adopted. We conclude that the adoption of costly policies with externalities may be less burdensome to shareholders than predicted.

abstract: The emergence of wearable electroencephalography (EEG) technologies presents new opportunities to identify and quantify neural correlates of decision-making in real-time, financially consequential settings. We report a field study in which we use wearable EEG devices to record brainwave activity from professional day traders during real-world, high-stakes trading. Using these signals, we construct an established psychophysiological Engagement Index (EI), which is defined as beta wave power divided by the sum of alpha and theta wave power, and document clear spike-and-decay patterns around trade execution. Linking EI dynamics to trading performance, we find that more successful trades are preceded by larger EI spikes in the 30 seconds before execution, while baseline or background EI levels have no predictive power and, if anything, are negatively associated with performance. We further show that higher EI is associated with attenuated behavioral biases in trading, including the round number heuristic and the disposition effect.

title: Estimating the value of information in the UK mortgage market

abstract: This paper measures the value of information mortgage brokers provide to UK households using an application of a structural model of search. Aided by administrative loans data, we document the existence of a substantial degree of unexplained price dispersion, and observe that while mortgages obtained from brokers are cheaper, borrowers who use intermediaries pay more once commissions are factored in. However, our results also show that broker presence exerts negative pressure on lenders’ market power. Compared to a world where broker advice is unavailable, brokers reduce average monthly mortgage costs by 21% and eliminate a part of welfare losses arising from costly search. In other words, eliminating brokers from the market would lead to even higher borrowing costs from the group of borrowers who need it most: those with the highest search costs. We also find that regulation in support of market centralization halves lenders’ markups and lowers monthly costs of an average mortgage by 4.4%.
abstract_zh: 本文通过应用搜索的结构模型，衡量了抵押贷款经纪人为英国家庭提供的信息价值。借助行政贷款数据，我们记录了存在显著程度的未解释价格离散现象，并观察到虽然通过经纪人获得的抵押贷款更便宜，但使用中介的借款人在计入佣金后支付更多。然而，我们的结果也表明，经纪人的存在对贷款人的市场势力施加了负面压力。与没有经纪人建议的世界相比，经纪人将平均月度抵押贷款成本降低了21%，并消除了因昂贵搜索而产生的部分福利损失。换言之，将经纪人从市场中剔除将导致最需要帮助的借款人群体——即搜索成本最高者——面临更高的借款成本。我们还发现，支持市场集中化的监管措施使贷款人的加价减半，并将平均抵押贷款的月度成本降低了4.4%。

abstract: Stock markets play a dual role: they provide information about firms’ fundamentals, which improves resource allocations, and they provide liquidity. We propose a setting in which these two roles interact: if stocks are used more intensively for liquidity, then prices reveal less information about fundamentals. We structurally estimate stock price informativeness for several countries and show that it declines when alternative liquidity sources, such as banks, are in distress. To study the real effects of this mechanism, we devise a strategy to integrate our stock-trading module into a dynamic general equilibrium model with heterogeneous firms. We calibrate the model to the US and simulate recessions with and without banking distress. In a stand-alone recession, prices become more informative, and allocation improves, mitigating output losses by 4.4%. If the recession coincides with banking distress, agents rely more on stock markets to obtain liquidity, prices become less informative, and allocation deteriorates, magnifying output losses by 22%.
abstract_zh: 股票市场具有双重作用：一方面提供企业基本面信息以优化资源配置，另一方面提供流动性。我们构建了一个两种作用相互影响的框架：若股票被更密集地用于获取流动性，则价格所反映的基本面信息将减少。我们通过结构估计测度了多国股票价格的信息含量，发现当银行等替代性流动性来源陷入困境时，股价信息含量会下降。为研究该机制的实际经济效应，我们设计策略将股票交易模块嵌入包含异质性企业的动态一般均衡模型。基于美国数据校准模型后，我们模拟了有无银行业困境伴随的经济衰退情景。在独立衰退中，价格信息含量提升，资源配置改善，使产出损失降低4.4%；若衰退伴随银行业困境，经济主体将更依赖股票市场获取流动性，导致价格信息含量下降与资源配置恶化，使产出损失扩大22%。

abstract: We show that carbon pricing and bank credit complement each other in reducing firms' carbon emission intensity. Our identification exploits a reform‐driven carbon price increase in the EU emission trading system (ETS) and administrative microdata, including the Italian credit registry. We find that highly exposed ETS firms increase term‐loan demand, relative to less exposed ETS firms. Such credit channel is associated with larger investment, but not with higher carbon emissions, reducing emission intensity. These effects are significant only among firms undertaking green investments. Moreover, higher credit demand by ETS firms crowds out credit supply to smaller firms in brown sectors.
abstract_zh: 我们证明，碳定价与银行信贷在降低企业碳排放强度方面具有互补作用。我们的识别策略利用了欧盟排放交易体系（ETS）改革驱动的碳价上涨以及包含意大利信贷登记系统的行政微观数据。研究发现，相较于受ETS影响较小的企业，受ETS影响较大的企业增加了定期贷款需求。这种信贷渠道与更大的投资规模相关，但并未导致碳排放增加，反而降低了排放强度。这些效应仅在进行绿色投资的企业中显著。此外，ETS企业信贷需求的增加挤出了对棕色行业中小企业的信贷供给。

title: Bridging and Dividing: The Dual Effects of Digital Inclusive Finance on Income Inequality in China

abstract: The rapid expansion of digital inclusive finance (DIF) in China offers substantial potential to advance common prosperity by broadening access to credit and lowering barriers to financial services. However, the distributional consequences—both between rural and urban areas and within regions—remain insufficiently understood. Using data from the China Household Financial Survey (CHFS) and DIF indices over the period 2011–2019, this paper investigates the effects of DIF on urban–rural income disparities and intra‐regional income inequality and explores the underlying mechanisms. We find that DIF significantly narrowed the urban–rural income gap while simultaneously exacerbating income disparities within both rural and urban areas. The reduction in the urban–rural divide was mainly attributable to disproportionate benefits accruing to rural households, largely through increases in agricultural income. In contrast, the widening of intra‐regional income disparities is predominantly due to DIF's stronger influence on middle‐ and high‐income groups, particularly those with higher levels of education. These findings highlight the dual‐edged nature of DIF in influencing income inequality and highlight the need for targeted policy interventions to promote a more equitable benefit distribution.
abstract_zh: 中国数字普惠金融（DIF）的迅速扩张，通过拓宽信贷渠道和降低金融服务门槛，为实现共同富裕提供了巨大潜力。然而，其分配效应——无论是在城乡之间还是区域内部——仍未得到充分理解。利用2011至2019年间中国家庭金融调查（CHFS）数据及数字普惠金融指数，本文考察了数字普惠金融对城乡收入差距和区域内收入不平等的影响，并探讨了其内在机制。研究发现，数字普惠金融显著缩小了城乡收入差距，同时加剧了农村和城市内部的收入不平等。城乡差距的缩小主要归因于农村家庭获得的不成比例的收益，这主要通过农业收入的增加实现。相比之下，区域内收入差距的扩大主要源于数字普惠金融对中高收入群体，尤其是教育水平较高者的更强影响。这些发现凸显了数字普惠金融在影响收入不平等方面的双刃剑特性，并强调了采取针对性政策干预以促进更公平利益分配的必要性。

title: Extreme heat and markets: Theoretical and empirical evidence from Nigeria

abstract: We investigate how exposure to extreme temperature affects smallholder commercialization. We examine a range of outcomes that indicate the degree of commercialization, including market participation, sales quantity, commercialization index, and sales revenue, which serves as an indicator of monetary benefit. Recognizing the non-separability between production and commercialization, we also examine how extreme temperature directly affects agricultural production. To address these questions, we develop a simple and straightforward theoretical framework that links temperature events to production and market dynamics. From this framework, we derive a set of hypotheses which we proceed to test empirically. Our empirical strategy leverages a comprehensive three-wave panel dataset, which we integrate with earth observation data on temperature extremes. We find that extreme temperatures lead to production losses. We also observe significant declines in market participation among smallholder farmers which could be explained by production shortfalls. This reduction is evident at both the extensive margin (likelihood of participating in markets) and the intensive margin (sales quantity). Furthermore, we observe that when farmers face extreme temperatures, the proportion of harvested crops they sell and the resulting revenue from these also decrease. Causal mediation analysis further confirms that production losses due to extreme temperatures explains the reduction in market outcomes. Overall, these findings highlight the broader economic burden that extreme weather events continue to impose on smallholder households.
abstract_zh: 我们研究了极端温度暴露如何影响小农户的商业化程度。我们考察了一系列反映商业化程度的指标，包括市场参与、销售量、商业化指数以及作为货币收益指标的销售收入。鉴于生产与商业化之间的不可分割性，我们还探讨了极端温度如何直接影响农业生产。为解答这些问题，我们构建了一个简洁明了的理论框架，将温度事件与生产和市场动态联系起来。基于此框架，我们推导出一系列假设，并随后进行实证检验。我们的实证策略利用了一个包含三轮调查的面板数据集，并将其与关于极端温度的地球观测数据相结合。我们发现极端温度导致生产损失。同时，我们观察到小农户的市场参与显著下降，这可由生产短缺来解释。这种减少在广度边际（参与市场的可能性）和强度边际（销售量）上均有所体现。此外，我们还发现，当农户面临极端温度时，其收获作物中出售的比例以及由此产生的收入也相应减少。因果中介分析进一步证实，极端温度导致的生产损失解释了市场结果的下降。总体而言，这些发现凸显了极端天气事件对小农户家庭持续施加的更广泛经济负担。

title: The effect of exit rights on cost-based procurement contracts

abstract: We analyze optimal procurement contracts when suppliers learn about project costs over time and retain an ex-post right to exit. In the first period, the firm observes a private signal on the likelihood of high costs; in the second, it learns the realized cost type and decides whether to continue or exercise its outside option. We show that when exit opportunities are sufficiently attractive, the optimal mechanism pools all first-period signals and reduces to a cost-plus contract, with payments tied only to realized, verifiable costs. Attempts to elicit cost forecasts ex-ante backfire: firms strategically under-report expectations, triggering exit in high-cost states and generating overruns. This provides a mechanism-based interpretation of cost overruns as failures of incentive design. Finally, we demonstrate that more generous outside options can raise procurement costs and lower firm profits, identifying conditions where limiting exit rights is ex-ante Pareto improving. (JEL D82, D86, H57)
abstract_zh: 我们分析了当供应商随时间了解项目成本并保留事后退出权时的最优采购合同。在第一阶段，企业观察到关于高成本可能性的私人信号；在第二阶段，它了解到实现的成本类型，并决定是继续还是行使外部选择权。我们表明，当退出机会足够有吸引力时，最优机制会汇集所有第一阶段的信号，并简化为成本加成合同，其中支付仅与已实现且可验证的成本挂钩。试图事前获取成本预测会适得其反：企业策略性地低估预期，导致高成本状态下退出并产生超支。这为成本超支作为激励设计失败提供了一种基于机制的解释。最后，我们证明更慷慨的外部选择权可以提高采购成本并降低企业利润，确定了限制退出权在事前帕累托改进的条件。（JEL D82, D86, H57）

abstract: This paper considers precautionary saving against the correlation between two risky attributes (wealth and health) and investigates how the correlation affects optimal savings under multivariate preferences. The signs of higher‐order cross‐derivatives play a key role in determining the direction of precautionary saving against such correlation. Mixed correlation‐averse (seeking) individuals increase (decrease) savings in response to increases in correlation. Furthermore, we introduce ambiguity to the correlation and investigate how ambiguity affects the amount of optimal savings. The analyses enable us to deepen our understanding of saving behavior under multivariate preferences in the presence of correlation.
abstract_zh: 本文探讨了针对财富与健康两种风险属性之间相关性的预防性储蓄行为，并研究了在多维偏好下，这种相关性如何影响最优储蓄水平。高阶交叉导数的符号在决定针对此类相关性的预防性储蓄方向上起着关键作用。混合相关性厌恶（偏好）型个体在面对相关性增强时会增加（减少）储蓄。此外，我们将模糊性引入相关性分析，并考察模糊性如何影响最优储蓄量。这些分析有助于深化我们对存在相关性时多维偏好下储蓄行为的理解。

title: Recommended, purchased, disappointed?- Exploring the divergent effects of algorithmic product recommendations on sales and satisfaction
title_zh: 推荐、购买、失望？——探究算法产品推荐对销售与满意度的差异化影响
title_primary: 推荐、购买、失望？——探究算法产品推荐对销售与满意度的差异化影响
title_secondary: Recommended, purchased, disappointed?- Exploring the divergent effects of algorithmic product recommendations on sales and satisfaction
authors: Yixing Yang Qiuhan Zhao Yifan Yang Jingen Zhou a Department of Electronic Business, South China University of Technology, Guangzhou, Chinab Department of Technology Management for Innovation, The University of Tokyo, Bunkyo-Ku, Japanc College of Modern Postal 等
official: 官方在线 2025-07-24 · 来源：RSS
abstract: With the rise of algorithmic commerce, data-driven product recommendations have become central to online retail. This study investigates whether such recommendations enhance product performance and consumer satisfaction, and how their effects vary by consumption timing (immediate vs. non-immediate) and product characteristics (price and type). Using real-time ‘Gold List’ rankings from JD.com, we analyse over 28,000 product records and consumer reviews. Satisfaction is quantified using a supervised Word2vec-SVM model, and effects are estimated using a double machine learning (DML) framework. Results show that recommendations significantly improve product performance, especially for non-immediate consumption and experience goods, but have limited or even negative effects on satisfaction. Topic modelling (LDA) of negative reviews reveals dissatisfaction drivers such as weak after-sales support and quality concerns. Robustness checks confirm the consistency of findings. This study contributes to understanding when and why algorithmic recommendations succeed or fail, offering insights for personalized retail strategies in AI-driven digital marketplaces.
abstract_zh: 随着算法商务的兴起，数据驱动的产品推荐已成为在线零售的核心。本研究探讨了此类推荐是否能够提升产品绩效与消费者满意度，并考察其效果如何因消费时机（即时与非即时）及产品特征（价格与类型）而异。基于京东实时“金榜”排名数据，我们分析了超过28,000条产品记录及消费者评论。满意度通过有监督的Word2vec-SVM模型进行量化，效果则采用双重机器学习（DML）框架进行估计。结果表明，推荐显著提升了产品绩效，尤其对非即时消费和体验型商品效果更为明显，但对满意度的提升作用有限甚至产生负面影响。对负面评论的主题建模（LDA）揭示了不满驱动因素，如售后支持薄弱和质量问题。稳健性检验确认了研究结果的一致性。本研究有助于理解算法推荐在何种情境下及为何会成功或失败，为人工智能驱动的数字市场中的个性化零售策略提供了洞见。

title: Relational Collusion in the Colombian Electricity Market
title_zh: 哥伦比亚电力市场中的关系性合谋
title_primary: 哥伦比亚电力市场中的关系性合谋
title_secondary: Relational Collusion in the Colombian Electricity Market
authors: Mario Bernasconi, Miguel Espinosa, Rocco Macchiavello, Carlos Suarez
official: 官方在线 2023-04-04 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: Under collusion, firms deviate from current profit maximization in anticipation of future rewards. As current profit maximization places little restrictions on firms' pricing behaviour, collusive conduct is hard to infer. Under collusion -- however -- firms' behaviour should instantaneously respond to the anticipation of future changes in their ability to sustain it. We show that bids from certain firms in the Colombian wholesale electricity market collapsed immediately after the announcement, and before the implementation, of a reform that potentially made collusion harder to sustain. A forensic analysis uncovers a type of coordinated behaviour among cartel members that likely required explicit communication and provides suggestive evidence that such communication might have occurred. A quantification exercise supports the reduced-form evidence on collusion and quantifies its costs. Dynamic enforcement constraints should be taken seriously by policy-makers fighting collusion.
abstract_zh: 在合谋状态下，企业会为预期未来收益而偏离当前利润最大化行为。由于当前利润最大化对企业定价行为的约束极小，合谋行为难以被推断。然而，在合谋状态下，企业行为应当会即时响应其对未来维持合谋能力变化的预期。我们研究发现，哥伦比亚批发电力市场中某些企业的报价，在一项可能削弱合谋可持续性的改革方案宣布后、实施前，便立即出现暴跌。法证分析揭示了卡特尔成员间一种很可能需要显性沟通的协调行为，并提供了此类沟通可能存在的暗示性证据。量化分析支持了关于合谋的简约形式证据，并估算了其成本。反合谋政策制定者应严肃对待动态执行约束问题。
